SQL_DOC.V_SQL: SELECT BUYER, GR_NO, GR_SEQ, STATUS FROM EAI.IF_UCUBE_GR_SEND WHERE BUYER IN (SELECT BUYER FROM IF_ADMIN WHERE BUYER_ID = 'IJST') AND IF_FLAG = 'N' ORDER BY BUYER, GR_NO, GR_SEQ, STATUS
SQL_DOC.P_SQL:
SELECT A.KEY_1 AS GR_ID, CASE WHEN A.BUYER = 'KRILJI0056' THEN 'NIS' WHEN A.BUYER = 'KRILJI0055' THEN 'NIJ' ELSE 'NIS' END AS PLANT, A.KEY_2 AS LEGACY_PO_NO, A.KEY_3 AS LEGACY_PO_SEQ, A.STATUS, TO_CHAR(CREATE_DATM, 'YYYYMMDD') AS ADD_DATE, TO_CHAR(CREATE_DATM, 'HH24MISS') AS ADD_TIME, A.BUYER_ITEM_NO, A.UNIT_PRICE, CASE WHEN A.STATUS = 'RCV' THEN A.GR_QTY ELSE 0 END AS GR_QTY, CASE WHEN A.STATUS = 'RCV' THEN A.GR_AMT ELSE 0 END AS GR_AMT, A.GR_DATE, A.KEY_4 AS RCV_USER, A.KEY_5 AS RCV_USER_DEPT_NAME, CASE WHEN A.STATUS = 'RTN' THEN A.GR_QTY ELSE 0 END AS RO_QTY, CASE WHEN A.STATUS = 'RTN' THEN A.GR_AMT ELSE 0 END AS RO_AMT, A.GR_NO AS KEP_GR_NO, A.GR_SEQ AS KEP_GR_SEQ, A.KEY_6 AS LEGACY_GR_NO, A.KEY_7 AS LEGACY_GR_SEQ FROM EAI.IF_UCUBE_GR_SEND A WHERE A.BUYER = '$G_RS.BUYER$' AND A.GR_NO = '$G_RS.GR_NO$' AND A.GR_SEQ = '$G_RS.GR_SEQ$' AND A.STATUS = '$G_RS.STATUS$'
UPDATE EAI.IF_UCUBE_GR_SEND A SET IF_FLAG = 'Y' , IF_DATM = SYSDATE WHERE A.BUYER = '$G_RS.BUYER$' AND A.GR_NO = '$G_RS.GR_NO$' AND A.GR_SEQ = '$G_RS.GR_SEQ$' AND A.STATUS = '$G_RS.STATUS$'
UPDATE EAI.IF_UCUBE_GR_SEND A SET IF_FLAG = 'E' , IF_DATM = SYSDATE WHERE A.BUYER = '$G_RS.BUYER$' AND A.GR_NO = '$G_RS.GR_NO$' AND A.GR_SEQ = '$G_RS.GR_SEQ$' AND A.STATUS = '$G_RS.STATUS$'
